spec.name: Blend v33
spec.notes: Combined signal, rebalanced on a slow schedule.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.6, annual return 9%, maximum drawdown 9%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a full sample backtest without out-of-sample validation, raising concerns about overfitting. The claimed performance is also likely overstated due to the omission of transaction costs in the backtest, despite the strategy specifying costs. The small number of trials and the fact that this is not the best performing variant further suggest caution. Paper trading is warranted to assess robustness.
